interests.title: Boxing
interests.heading: My boxing journey.
interests.description: From my first day at Church Street Boxing Gym in January 2024 to hundreds of rounds, and a goal of an amateur fight in 2027.
interests.intro: I started boxing in January 2024 at Church Street Boxing Gym in Chelsea. What started as a way to get fit became a hobby, a bit of an addiction, and an outlet I can’t imagine my weeks without.

interests.heading: Life in New York in my 20s.
interests.description: General life thoughts, new interests, and figuring things out as a 20-something in New York.
interests.intro:
I wanted this site to have room for the everyday side of my life in New York, too.

This is where I’ll share personal thoughts, updates, and things I’m learning or picking up in my 20s, beyond the work and the technical topics.
